name: Waffy Chocolate
ingredients: REFINED WHEAT FLOUR (MAIDA), SUGAR, REFINED PALM OIL, HYDROGENATED OILS, MALTODEXTRIN, COCOA SOLIDS (1.5 %), EMULSIFIER [INS 322(1)], ARTIFICIAL FLAVOURING SUBSTANCES (CHOCOLATE, VANILLA), IODIZED SALT, RAISING AGENT [INS 500 (ii)], COLOUR (INS 150d), FLOUR TREATMENT AGENTS (INS 223, INS 1100, INS 1101).
